bio: In this former corn mill, the Lemke family now run a restaurant that serves excellent food. There are two comfortable dining spaces – the Mühlenstube and the Kaminzimmer – plus a delightful terrace where you can tuck into delicious seasonal and regional dishes. Opt for one of two set menus (Westfälisch Genießen-Menü or Unser Windmühlen-Menü), or go à la carte. The friendly and attentive front-of-house team take delight in talking diners through their selection of German wines....
